claims: The Artemis II mission is scheduled for April 2026.
The Artemis II mission features a four-person crew.
Reid Wiseman (NASA) is the Commander of the Artemis II mission.
Victor Glover (NASA) is the Pilot of the Artemis II mission.
Christina Koch (NASA) is a Mission Specialist of the Artemis II mission.
Jeremy Hansen (Canadian Space Agency) is a Mission Specialist of the Artemis II mission.
The Artemis II mission crew will perform the first crewed lunar flyby in over 50 years.
